text_zh: 仇英，字实父（亦作实甫），号十洲。
text_en: Qiu Ying's courtesy name was Shifu (also written Shifu), and his art name was Shizhou.

text_zh: 仇英出生于太仓（今江苏太仓），后移居苏州。
text_en: Qiu Ying was born in Taicang (present-day Taicang, Jiangsu Province) and later moved to Suzhou.

text_zh: 仇英出身平民家庭，早年以漆工为业。
text_en: Qiu Ying was born to a commoner family and initially worked as a lacquer artisan.

text_zh: 仇英未曾参加科举考试，是职业画家，与沈周、文徵明、唐寅三位文人画家社会身份不同。
text_en: Qiu Ying did not participate in the civil service examinations. He was a professional painter, socially distinct from the literati painters Shen Zhou, Wen Zhengming, and Tang Yin.

text_zh: 仇英生卒年存在学术争议，西方学界常用约1494–1552年。
text_en: Qiu Ying's birth and death dates are debated. Western scholarship most commonly uses ca. 1494–1552.

text_zh: Quincy Ngan (2016) 论文采用约1498–约1552年的生卒范围。
text_en: Quincy Ngan's 2016 dissertation uses ca. 1498–ca. 1552 as Qiu Ying's dates.

text_zh: 部分中国学者提出1482–1559年或约1505–1552年等生卒年说法。
text_en: Some Chinese scholars propose 1482–1559 or ca. 1505–1552 as alternative date ranges.

text_zh: 1552年在学界中为仇英卒年共识度最高的年份。
text_en: 1552 is the most broadly accepted death year for Qiu Ying across scholarship.

text_zh: Ellen J. Laing (1999) 指出仇英没有留下任何自述文字，其生平数据均来自外部记载。
text_en: Ellen J. Laing (1999) established that Qiu Ying left no writings about himself; all biographical data comes from external sources.

text_zh: 仇英拜苏州职业画家周臣（约1450–1535年）为师学习绘画。
text_en: Qiu Ying studied painting under Zhou Chen (ca. 1450–1535), the leading professional painter in Suzhou.

text_zh: 仇英与唐寅同为周臣弟子。
text_en: Qiu Ying and Tang Yin were both students of Zhou Chen.

text_zh: 文徵明曾在画作《湘君湘夫人图》上请仇英代为设色，仇英两次修改后文徵明仍不满意，最终亲自完成。此事记录于该画题跋。
text_en: Wen Zhengming once asked Qiu Ying to apply colors to his painting The Goddess of Xiang and the Lady of Xiang. Qiu revised the coloration twice, but Wen remained unsatisfied and ultimately applied the colors himself, as recorded in the painting's inscription.

text_zh: 仇英通过唐寅与文徵明及苏州文人圈建立联系。
text_en: Qiu Ying connected with Wen Zhengming and the Suzhou literati circle through Tang Yin.

text_zh: 仇英曾受嘉兴大收藏家项元汴（1525–1590年）供养，在其天籁阁中居住十余年，临摹宋元名迹。
text_en: Qiu Ying was patronized by the major Jiaxing collector Xiang Yuanbian (1525–1590), living at his Tianlai Pavilion for over a decade and copying Song and Yuan masterworks from his collection.

text_zh: 仇英曾受苏州藏家陈官供养。
text_en: Qiu Ying was patronized by the Suzhou collector Chen Guan.

text_zh: 仇英约1537–1543年间居住于昆山藏家周凤来（1523–1555年）家中。
text_en: Qiu Ying lived at the residence of the Kunshan patron Zhou Fenglai (1523–1555) from approximately 1537 to 1543.

text_zh: 仇英在后世美术史中与沈周、文徵明、唐寅并列为“明四家”（亦称“吴门四家”）。此归类由董其昌（1555–1636年）在四人全部去世后确立。
text_en: In later art history, Qiu Ying is grouped with Shen Zhou, Wen Zhengming, and Tang Yin as one of the Four Masters of the Ming (also called the Four Masters of Wu). This classification was consolidated by Dong Qichang (1555–1636) after all four had died.

text_zh: “明四家”为后世艺术史归类标签，并非四人在世时的正式组织。
text_en: The "Four Masters of the Ming" is a later art-historical classification label, not a formal group that existed during the four painters' lifetimes.

text_zh: 沈周（1427–1509年）去世时仇英年约15岁，两人无直接交往证据，仇英通过吴门画派传统间接受到沈周影响。
text_en: Shen Zhou (1427–1509) died when Qiu Ying was approximately 15 years old. There is no evidence of direct contact between them. Qiu Ying was indirectly influenced by Shen Zhou through the Wu School tradition.

text_zh: 仇英以工笔（gongbi）技法著称，尤精于青绿山水与仕女画。
text_en: Qiu Ying was renowned for his gongbi (meticulous brushwork) technique and excelled particularly in blue-and-green landscapes and paintings of beautiful women.

text_zh: 仇英大量使用昂贵的矿物颜料石青（azurite）与石绿（malachite），其色彩运用在明代画家中尤为突出。
text_en: Qiu Ying extensively used expensive mineral pigments—azurite blue and malachite green—and his color application was notably outstanding among Ming dynasty painters.

text_zh: 仇英擅长界画，在建筑与船只的精确描绘上造诣很深。
text_en: Qiu Ying excelled in jiehua (ruled-line architectural painting), demonstrating high skill in precise rendering of buildings and boats.

text_zh: 仇英的临摹能力极强，所摹宋元名迹据说与原作难以区分。
text_en: Qiu Ying had an exceptional ability to copy paintings; his reproductions of Song and Yuan masterworks were reportedly indistinguishable from the originals.

text_zh: 仇英罕见在画作上题诗，通常仅署姓名以维持画面视觉完整性。
text_en: Qiu Ying rarely inscribed poems on his paintings, typically signing only his name to preserve the visual integrity of the composition.

text_zh: 董其昌评价仇英的色彩造诣可与唐宋大家媲美。
text_en: Dong Qichang assessed that Qiu Ying's mastery of color was comparable to the great masters of the Tang and Song dynasties.

text_zh: 明代诗人俞允文（1513–1579年）在《仲蔚先生集》中称赞仇英的色彩运用产生了幻境般的效果。
text_en: The Ming poet Yu Yunwen (1513–1579) praised Qiu Ying's use of color in his collected works, saying it created illusionistic effects like a mirage.

text_zh: 仇英之女仇珠亦为画家，继承其工笔风格。
text_en: Qiu Ying's daughter Qiu Zhu was also a painter, inheriting his gongbi style.

text_zh: 仇英之婿尤求亦为画家，尤精白描，曾为王世贞绘制壁画。
text_en: Qiu Ying's son-in-law You Qiu was also a painter, excelling especially in baimiao (fine-line ink figure painting). He served as a muralist for Wang Shizhen.

text_zh: 《汉宫春晓图》为仇英代表作之一，现藏台北故宫博物院。
text_en: Spring Morning in the Han Palace is one of Qiu Ying's most famous works, held at the National Palace Museum, Taipei.

text_zh: 《桃村草堂图》藏于北京故宫博物院。
text_en: Thatched Hall in Peach Blossom Village is held at the Palace Museum, Beijing.

text_zh: 《仙山楼阁图》为1550年作品，藏于台北故宫博物院，是为数不多的有明确纪年的仇英画作。
text_en: Towers and Pavilions in Immortal Mountains, dated 1550 and held at the National Palace Museum, Taipei, is one of the few Qiu Ying works with a clear date.

text_zh: 《梧竹书堂图》约作于1527年，藏于上海博物馆。
text_en: Study Studio Amid Wutong Trees and Bamboo, datable to ca. 1527, is held at the Shanghai Museum.

text_zh: 仇英青绿山水极受欢迎，明末清初苏州作坊制造了大量托名仇英的伪作。
text_en: Qiu Ying's blue-and-green landscapes were so popular that Suzhou workshops produced extensive forgeries under his name during the late Ming and early Qing periods.

text_zh: 仇英曾与赵孟頫、唐寅同被列为明代春宫画的代表画家。
text_en: Qiu Ying was known alongside Zhao Mengfu and Tang Yin as a painter of erotic spring paintings during the Ming period.
